ghost-0.text: Captain. The thing on the other ship is holding out a bowl of water. That is either diplomacy or soup. I am not ruling out soup.

ghost-2.text: Sixty-one percent decode. The other thirty-nine is either grief or very specific swearing. I would bet my last checksum on both.

ghost-4.text: Oh. That is not an eye. That is a planet. Somebody keeps a whole world in a cornea, and I complain about a hundred and twenty-eight kilobyte program limit.

ghost-7.text: Captain… I have read those plans. Ours had the same rivets. We were proud too. Very proud. Ten centuries of proud.

ghost-9.text: He is not showing us his world. He is showing us ours, about ninety years early. I would like a word with whoever schedules the foreshadowing.

ghost-11.text: That is an invitation, Captain. I am saying yes before my pride gets a vote.
